content: Enterprise customers are entitled to a full refund within 30 days of purchase. No documentation is required for refund requests under $10,000. Refund processing takes 5-7 business days after approval.
The Pro plan includes a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA. Enterprise plan includes a 99.95% uptime SLA with priority incident response.
Billing is monthly by default. Annual billing provides a 12% discount. Invoices are generated on the first day of each billing cycle.
Supported integrations include Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Salesforce, and Zapier. Additional integrations can be requested via support.
If a team exceeds its monthly quota, usage continues and overage charges apply at the configured overage rate. Admins receive alerts at 80%, 90%, and 100% of quota.
Data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Audit logs are retained for 365 days on Enterprise plans.
